Characters are addons that use the [[API|Citizens API]] to add functionality to existing NPCs. Download and install their plugin JAR into the ''/plugins'' directory.

Citizens NPCs can contain multiple traits at the same time. See [[Multiple Traits]]

==Suggested Addons==

There is no guarantee of any of these still being available/updated. If you would like to be added to the list please message the team on Discord.

There are also many addons available outside of the wiki.
